veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat gently

steps.text: Season the plant-based mince with salt and pepper and roll into 20 balls with oiled hands, pressing a thumb dent into each.
Brush the balls with half the olive oil and bake at 220C until browned.
Fry the mushrooms in the rest of the oil in a wide pan, then add the stock, cream and Dijon and simmer.
Add the balls and simmer gently until hot through.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the haloumi fingers up to 1 day ahead, laid on a tray in the fridge; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into 20 thick fingers and pat dry.
Dip in flour, then egg, then panko.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until golden.
Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 1 day ahead, assemble up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the beetroot paper thin and toss with the lemon juice, smoked paprika and salt. Leave for 10 minutes.
Butter the rye.
Top with creme fraiche, folds of beetroot, a few capers and dill sprigs.
Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the agar into the water in a saucepan and boil, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Take off the heat and whisk in the jelly crystals until dissolved.
Pour into a lined slab tin, cool, then chill until firm.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Cut the jelly into jagged shards, pile on a plate and serve with the whipped cream.

veg.make_ahead: Make the salsa and crumb the haloumi up to 3 hours ahead, chilled; fry the haloumi just before serving

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into 16 bite-sized cubes and pat dry.
Mix the coconut and panko. Dip the haloumi in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.
Dice the pineapple, red onion and chilli and mix with lime juice for a salsa.
Fry the haloumi in the vegetable oil at 180C in batches until golden, then drain.
Serve each bite on a spoonful of salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs hard and simmer the black lentils in a second pan until just tender.
Cool the eggs, peel and halve. Drain the lentils and dress with the soy and a squeeze of lemon.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise and Dijon, pipe back into the whites and top with the dressed lentils.
Slice the eggplant lengthways into thin ribbons, brush with the oil, dust with smoked paprika and grill until soft and charred.
Blanch the asparagus.
Wrap each spear in a ribbon of smoky eggplant.

veg.make_ahead: Steam the cauliflower and crumb it up to 2 hours ahead, chilled; slice and fry the plantains and cauliflower just before serving

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets, steam for 4 minutes until just tender and pat dry.
Mix the coconut and panko. Dip the florets in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.
Peel the plantains and slice thin.
Fry the cauliflower in the oil at 180C in batches until golden.
Fry the plantain slices until crisp.
Serve both with sweet chilli.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and seed the rockmelon and cut into 20 cubes.
Slice the eggplant lengthways into 10 thin ribbons and halve them. Brush with half the oil, season with smoked paprika and salt and grill until soft and charred.
Wrap each cube in a ribbon of eggplant with a basil leaf tucked inside and spear with a pick.
Arrange on a platter, drizzle with balsamic and the rest of the oil and finish with pepper.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cut the tofu and crumb it up to 2 hours ahead, kept chilled, and blitz the mango dip up to 1 day ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Press the tofu between paper towels under a weight, then cut into 20 fingers and season with the salt. Mix the panko and coconut.
Dip in flour, egg, then the coconut crumb.
Blitz the mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until golden.

veg.n: Post-battle hummus with spiced plant-based mince
veg.make_ahead: Hummus up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, salt and ice water until very smooth.
Fry the plant-based mince in the olive oil until crisp, adding the cumin, cinnamon and paprika.
Toast the pine nuts and warm the flatbreads.
Swirl the hummus onto a plate and spoon the hot mince over.
Add pine nuts, chilli oil and parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Watermelon mix up to 1 hour ahead, assemble to serve

steps.text: Fry the wonton wrappers at 180C until crisp. Drain.
Cut the watermelon into 1cm dice, pat dry and dress with soy, sesame oil, lime juice and spring onion. Leave for 10 minutes.
Smash the avocado.
Spoon the watermelon onto the wontons and top with a dot of avocado and the sesame.

veg.make_ahead: Roll up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Lay the pastry flat and spread each sheet with tomato paste.
Scatter with the plant-based ham, pineapple and mozzarella.
Roll up tightly and slice into 2cm pinwheels.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

veg.make_ahead: Prep the lettuce, tomatoes and onion up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; fry the plant-based mince fresh

steps.text: Prep the lettuce and tomatoes.
Fry the plant-based mince and onion in the oil on a hot griddle, chopping it up with two spatulas, and season well.
Lay the cheese over, let it melt and chop it through.
Pile into the rolls with lettuce, tomato, tomato sauce and mayonnaise.

veg.make_ahead: Stir up the mustard mayo up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build the stacks on the night so the toast stays crisp

steps.text: Mix the mayo with the wholegrain mustard.
Toast the bread.
Build four stacks: toast, sauce, plant-based ham and Swiss, toast, sauce, plant-based ham, cheddar and pickles, then toast.
Press lightly, cut each into three fingers and pin with toothpicks.
Slice the apples and toss with lemon juice to serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Cube the cheddar and slice the smoked tofu up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; arrange on the plate to serve

steps.text: Cube the cheddar and slice the smoked tofu thin.
Arrange the crackers, cheddar and smoked tofu on a shared plate in the middle of the table.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the sausages and dice the mozzarella up to 1 day ahead; press, fill and bake on the night

steps.text: Knead the cornmeal into the dough and press into a 12-hole mini muffin tin.
Chop the vegetarian sausages into small pieces.
Fill the cases with mozzarella, sausage pieces and crushed tomato.
Bake at 210C until bubbling.

veg.make_ahead: Tartlets up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Cut rounds from the pastry and line a 12-hole tin.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, add the smoked tofu and chopped chives and fill the cases.
Bake at 180C until set and golden.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with a squeeze of lemon.
Cut thick cucumber rounds and top with folds of beetroot.

veg.make_ahead: Cook from frozen on the night; the dipping sauce keeps in the fridge up to 1 day

steps.text: Mix the soy, black vinegar and spring onion for dipping.
Fry the dumplings flat side down in a little oil until golden.
Add water, cover and steam.
Uncover and crisp again.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the rounds up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; top and bake just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C. Roll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds.
Spread each with pizza sauce, add mozzarella and a slice of plant-based pepperoni.
Bake until bubbling.
Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt for the rims up to 1 week ahead in a jar; add the lager last so it stays fizzy

steps.text: Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a saucer. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and soy sauce to each.
Top slowly with cold lager, stir once and serve with a lime wedge.

veg_af.make_ahead: Mix the chilli salt for the rims up to 1 week ahead in a jar; add the alcohol-free lager last so it stays fizzy

steps.text: Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a saucer. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and soy sauce to each.
Top slowly with cold alcohol-free lager, stir once and serve with a lime wedge.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the potatoes and fry the smoked tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; crisp, fill and top on the night

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C until tender.
Halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and golden.
Brush the skins with butter and crisp at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and smoked tofu and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream and chopped chives.

veg.make_ahead: Best toasted and eaten warm; the chocolate can be melted up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Melt the chocolate in a bowl over hot water.
Toast the marshmallows on sticks over the fire or a gas flame until blistered.
Dip in the chocolate and squash between two biscuits. Eat while still gooey.

veg.make_ahead: Make up to 6 hours ahead, wrapped and chilled, so the bread stays soft

steps.text: Butter the bread and spread with mustard.
Fill with plant-based ham, cheddar and pickles.
Cut in half and wrap each tightly in wax paper.

veg.n: Staff cabin onion dip and pretzels (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Dip keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Cook the onions in butter over low heat, stirring often, until deep brown and jammy.
Cool and chop finely.
Beat the sour cream with the cream cheese, soy sauce and salt, then fold in the onions and chives.
Chill the dip.
Serve with pretzels and potato chips.

veg.make_ahead: Roll and cut the 16 rounds up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; top and bake on the night

steps.text: Roll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds.
Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and a slice of plant-based pepperoni.
Bake at 230C until bubbling and golden. Serve in a pizza box.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days in a sealed container

steps.text: Chop the chocolate bars into chunks and tear the plant-based jerky into bite-sized pieces.
Tip the peanuts, pretzels, chocolate and jerky into a shared bowl and mix gently.
Divide between four people for the motel snack break.

veg.make_ahead: Whisk the batter up to 2 hours ahead and keep it chilled; fry the vegetarian hot dogs fresh and serve hot

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a batter.
Pat the vegetarian hot dogs dry and push onto sticks.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip in the batter and fry until deep golden.
Serve with mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cheddar and drain the capsicum up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; thread the toothpicks on the day

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into 20 even cubes.
Thread each onto a toothpick with a fold of roasted capsicum and a cherry tomato.
Lay out in two neat rows of exactly ten.

veg.n: Vegas buffet hearts of palm cocktail
veg.make_ahead: Drain and chop the hearts of palm and mix the sauce up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; pile on ice to serve

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm, cut into thick chunks and chill in iced water, then drain well.
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.
Pile the hearts of palm on crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Fresh strawberry jelly with vanilla cream (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Set up to 1 day ahead, whip cream on the day

steps.text: Hull and blend most of the strawberries with the sugar and lemon juice, then strain.
Whisk the agar into a cup of the puree in a small pan and boil, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Quickly stir into the rest of the puree and pour into four glasses over the remaining sliced strawberries.
Chill until set.
Whip the cream with vanilla paste and icing sugar, spoon on and crumble over the shortbread.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the chocolate up to 1 week ahead; heat the milk and whisk to order, then whip the cream and top

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming without boiling.
Add the chocolate and whisk until melted and frothy.
Divide among four mugs.
Softly whip the cream, spoon on top and finish with marshmallows.

veg.make_ahead: Make the blue cheese dip up to 2 days ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; trim the mushrooms and cut the celery up to 1 day ahead. Fry and toss just before serving.

steps.text: Trim the oyster mushrooms into thick clusters.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over high heat, add the mushrooms in batches, press down with a plate and fry for 5 minutes each side until crisp. Season with the salt.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the mushrooms through.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for a dip and serve with the celery sticks.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Divide the plant-based mince into 12 small balls and dice the onion.
Smash the balls into thin patties on a hot griddle, salt well and flip after a minute or two.
Lay a slice of cheese on each patty to melt.
Fill soft buns with the patties, onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayonnaise, the way they do it in Amsterdam.

veg.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin and brown sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Shape the plant-based mince into 12 small patties and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred and cut each into 3.
Cook the patties on a hot griddle for 2 minutes a side, brush with the teriyaki and top each with a small square of cheddar.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Fill the slider buns with the patties, pineapple and sriracha mayonnaise and hold each together with a toothpick.

veg_af.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, apple juice, rice vinegar and brown sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Shape the plant-based mince into 12 small patties and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred and cut each into 3.
Cook the patties on a hot griddle for 2 minutes a side, brush with the teriyaki and top each with a small square of cheddar.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Fill the slider buns with the patties, pineapple and sriracha mayonnaise and hold each together with a toothpick.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs until just combined.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes.
Cook ladlefuls in butter in a frying pan until bubbles set, flip and cook through, keeping the stack warm.
Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and brush with a little maple syrup. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup, with the smoky tofu on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Fill the sandwiches up to 3 hours ahead and keep wrapped in the fridge; trim the crusts and cut into triangles to serve

steps.text: Butter the bread and spread with Dijon.
Fill with plant-based ham and Swiss cheese.
Cut off the crusts and cut into neat triangles.
Serve on a plate with a glass of milk alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Pate sets 2 hours, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and garlic in a third of the butter over high heat until all the liquid has gone and they are well browned.
Flame with the brandy.
Blitz with the rest of the soft butter, the walnuts, thyme and salt until smooth.
Press into a dish and chill until set.
Slice and toast the baguette and spread with the pate and a little fig jam.

veg_af.make_ahead: Pate sets 2 hours, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms and garlic in a third of the butter over high heat until all the liquid has gone and they are well browned.
Add the verjuice and let it bubble away.
Blitz with the rest of the soft butter, the walnuts, thyme and salt until smooth.
Press into a dish and chill until set.
Slice and toast the baguette and spread with the pate and a little fig jam.

veg.make_ahead: Make the egg and cress filling up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; assemble the sandwiches and wrap them up to 3 hours ahead, kept chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise.
Stir in the cress.
Butter the bread.
Make two egg-and-cress sandwiches and two plant-based ham and mustard sandwiches.
Trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into four small pieces.
Wrap in wax paper for a 1968-style picnic.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Beat the cheddar with the cream cheese, half the paprika and the soy sauce.
Shape into a ball and chill.
Score lines like a pumpkin and roll in the remaining paprika.
Push a capsicum stem on top and serve with crackers.

veg.make_ahead: Make a day ahead

steps.text: Blitz most of the raspberries with the sugar and water, then strain into a saucepan.
Whisk in the agar and boil, stirring, for 2 minutes. Stir in the lemon juice.
Pour into four shallow glass dishes, cool and set in the fridge.
Top with the remaining fresh raspberries.

veg.make_ahead: Mix and roll the plant-based balls up to 8 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; brown and simmer in the sauce on the night

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the plant-based mince, onion, allspice and egg.
Roll into small balls.
Brown in the butter.
Simmer in the stock and cream until the sauce thickens.
Serve with lingonberry jam.

veg.make_ahead: Make a day ahead

steps.text: Press the crushed biscuits and butter into a lined tin and chill.
Boil the agar in the water for 2 minutes, stirring, then quickly whisk into the condensed milk with the lemon juice and spread over the base.
Chill until set.
Make the jelly as the packet says, cool until just warm and pour over.
Chill until firm.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the mince chilli up to 2 days ahead and reheat; heat the frankfurts and build the bites on the night

ingredients.item: brown onion, diced, for the chilli
brown onion, finely diced, for the topping

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the onion, cumin and paprika.
Add the water and simmer until thick.
Simmer the vegetarian frankfurts in a pan of water until hot.
Tuck them into split mini rolls, spoon over the chilli and add mustard and the extra diced onion.

veg.make_ahead: Make the glaze up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; coat and fry the cauliflower just before serving, as the crust softens

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Whisk the potato starch with the cold water and toss the florets through to coat.
Fry in the oil at 160C.
Rest.
Fry again at 190C until very crisp.
Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and garlic until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the kombu and shiitake broth up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled; cook the rice cakes in it just before serving

steps.text: Soak the rice cakes in water.
Simmer the water with the kombu and shiitake for 10 minutes, lift them out, then stir in the gochujang, gochugaru and sugar.
Add the rice cakes and tofu puffs and simmer until thick and glossy.
Top with spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Slice and dress the beetroot and whip the goat's cheese up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; assemble just before serving

steps.text: Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with a squeeze of lemon juice.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, folds of beetroot, dill and grated lemon zest.
Cut the cucumber into thick rounds.
Whip the goat's cheese with chives and pipe onto the rounds.
Lay both neatly on silver trays.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, airtight; pour the cold milk to serve

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pan and cook until it smells nutty.
Add the marshmallows and salt and stir until melted.
Off the heat, fold in the cereal quickly.
Press into a lined 20cm square tin with a buttered spatula.
Cool, then cut into 16 bars.
Serve with tall glasses of cold milk, kept separate.

veg.make_ahead: Make a day ahead

steps.text: Warm the cream with most of the sugar and the split, scraped vanilla bean. Whisk in the agar and simmer, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Pour into four teacups, cool and chill until set.
Simmer the berries with the rest of the sugar and spoon on top.
Serve with silver spoons.

veg.make_ahead: Make the egg filling up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; assemble up to 3 hours ahead, covered with a damp tea towel

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise and cress.
Use the slices of white bread to make egg sandwiches, cucumber and cream cheese sandwiches, and plant-based ham and Dijon sandwiches.
Cut off the crusts and cut into exact little squares.
Stand them up in rows.

veg.n: Lettuce leaf tofu and rice cups
veg.make_ahead: Fry the tofu and mix the dressing up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; cook the rice and fill the cups on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, crumble it and fry in the oil until golden, then splash with 1 tbsp of the soy.
Cook the rice.
Mix the lime juice, remaining soy, sugar and chilli for the dressing.
Separate the lettuce into cups.
Fill each with rice, tofu, cucumber, mint and coriander, spoon over the dressing and finish with peanuts.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the beans the night before. Cooked beans keep 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight (not counted in the time).
Drain and simmer the beans in fresh water until just tender.
Fry the smoked tofu and onion in the oil until golden.
Bake at 150C with the beans, molasses, mustard powder, smoked paprika, soy and enough water to cover.
Toast the sourdough and butter it.
Spoon the beans over the toast.

veg.n: Banana Boat hearts of palm cocktail
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm and cut into thick chunks.
Chill in iced water, then drain well.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and hot sauce.
Shred half the lettuce into four glasses, pile in the hearts of palm and spoon the sauce over.

veg.make_ahead: Best eaten the same day, keep in an airtight tin

steps.text: Cut the rice paper sheets into quarters with scissors.
Heat the oil to 190C in a deep pan.
Fry a few pieces at a time for a few seconds until puffed and blistered, then drain.
Toss with the salt flakes and smoked paprika while hot.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Boil four eggs, cool and peel.
Wrap each in a quarter of the vegetarian sausage meat.
Roll in flour, the beaten fifth egg and panko.
Deep fry in the vegetable oil at 170C until deep golden.
Halve and serve with English mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and score the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge, and mix the horseradish cream up to 2 days ahead; season and sear to order

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into thick coins, score the cut faces and season with the salt.
Sear in the oil in a smoking pan in batches until well browned.
Baste with the butter, garlic and thyme.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and serve with the mushrooms on toothpicks.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the sloppy joe filling up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; reheat and fill the buns on the night

steps.text: Dice the onion and capsicum.
Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the onion and capsicum.
Add the tomato sauce, soy, sugar, mustard and water and simmer until thick.
Split the buns and lay half a slice of cheddar on each base.
Spoon on the mince and top with pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Make the egg filling and slice the beetroot up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; assemble and cut up to 3 hours ahead, covered with a damp tea towel

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise and cress.
Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with a squeeze of lemon.
Use the white bread to make cucumber and cream cheese, egg, and beetroot, cream cheese and dill sandwiches.
Cut off the crusts and cut into fingers.
Lay on a tiered stand.

veg.n: Hotel Excelsior hearts of palm sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Mix the hearts of palm filling up to 1 day ahead, chilled; assemble, trim and cut up to 2 hours ahead, covered with a damp tea towel

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork, pat dry and mix with the mayonnaise, lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, chives, nori and pepper.
Butter the bread.
Spread the filling over half the slices and lay thin cucumber on top.
Close with the remaining bread, press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each into three fingers.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the plant-based mince up to 2 days ahead and reheat; shred the lettuce and cut the capsicum up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled. Warm the shells and fill on the night

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the cumin.
Shred the lettuce and cut the capsicum into strips.
Warm the shells.
Fill with mince, lettuce and cheddar.
Hang a strip of red capsicum out of each like a tongue.

veg.make_ahead: Warm the olives and grill the eggplant up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; slice the provolone and arrange the board on the night

ingredients.item: olive oil, for warming the olives

steps.text: Warm the olives in the olive oil with orange peel, garlic and chilli flakes, then cool.
Slice the eggplant into thin rounds, brush with the olive oil for the eggplant, season with salt and grill until charred and soft.
Slice the provolone.
Arrange on a big board in tidy rows with the olives, grilled eggplant, giardiniera, artichokes, grissini and cornichons.
Serve at room temperature.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the sauce with the vegetarian franks up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; reheat gently with a splash of water before serving

steps.text: Simmer the vegetarian frankfurts in the tomato sauce, sugar, mustard and water, stirring until sticky and glossy.
Pile into a warm bowl with toothpicks for picking.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the plant-based kabana and cube the cheese up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; thread and serve with the crackers

steps.text: Slice the plant-based kabana on the diagonal.
Cut the cheese into cubes.
Thread onto toothpicks with pickled onions.
Lay out on a plastic platter with crackers. It is the vibe.

veg.make_ahead: Drain and cut the hearts of palm and mix the sauce up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; pile on ice to serve

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm, pat dry and cut into thick chunks on the diagonal.
Pile on crushed ice.
Mix the mayo, tomato sauce, soy and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve with lemon wedges, and put the platter in the pool room after.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead and keep in cold water in the fridge; do the first fry up to 3 hours ahead and leave on a tray. Second fry and gravy on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and dry.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 140C until cooked through.
Fry again at 190C until golden.
Toss in the chicken-style salt.
Whisk the gravy powder into the boiling water.
Serve in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes and dice the onion up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; crumble the tofu up to 1 day ahead. Fry the hash and eggs on the night

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes for 6 minutes, then drain.
Fry the onion in the butter until soft.
Add the potato, crumble in the smoked tofu and splash with the soy. Press flat and fry without stirring until crusty, then turn and repeat.
Fry the eggs.
Serve the hash in clean empty tins with an egg on top.

veg.make_ahead: Parboil and steam dry the chips up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, and mix the dipping mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead; batter and fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and parboil, then drain and steam dry.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager and salt.
Dip the chips in the batter.
Fry in batches in the oil at 180C until golden.
Drain and toss with the chicken-style salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with garlic and lemon juice for dipping.

veg_af.make_ahead: Parboil and steam dry the chips up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, and mix the dipping mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead; batter and fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and parboil, then drain and steam dry.
Whisk the flour with the cold soda water and salt.
Dip the chips in the batter.
Fry in batches in the oil at 180C until golden.
Drain and toss with the chicken-style salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with garlic and lemon juice for dipping.

veg.n: Rock and roll king oyster mushroom pies
veg.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; fill, top and bake the pies on the day

steps.text: Soften the onion in half the butter.
Add the curry powder and cream and simmer until thick.
Cut the mushrooms into thick coins, sear in the rest of the butter until golden, stir into the sauce and cool.
Line patty tins with shortcrust and fill.
Top with puff.
Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into bite-sized cubes and fry in a dry non-stick pan until golden on all sides, then cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, soy sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon.
Shred the lettuce into four glasses, pile on the haloumi and spoon over the sauce. Hang a lemon wedge on each rim.

veg.make_ahead: Cases up to 1 day, fill and warm to serve

steps.text: Thaw the pastry. Cut 16 rounds, press a smaller cutter into each, and place on trays.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden, then push the centres down.
Chop the mushrooms and slice the leek. Fry both in the butter until golden.
Add the cream, tarragon and a squeeze of lemon and simmer until thick.
Fill the cases and warm through in the oven.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the beetroot paper thin and dress with a squeeze of lemon.
Top the blinis with crème fraîche, folds of beetroot and dill.
Cut the cucumber into thick rounds, scoop a small hollow in each and whip the goat's cheese smooth.
Fill the cucumber cups with the cheese and lay everything on trays.

veg.n: Outback pub lentil and mushroom rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, or freeze

steps.text: Grate the onion and carrot and fry with the mushrooms in the oil until dry and browned.
Mash with the lentils, breadcrumbs, soy, herbs and one egg, then cool.
Lay the filling along each pastry sheet, roll up, brush with the other egg, beaten, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Cut into 16 pieces and bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Serve with tomato sauce.

veg.n: High country roast beetroot and cheddar sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 3 days, assemble on the day

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil with the oil, salt and crushed peppercorns and roast at 200C until tender.
Cool, rub off the skins and slice thin.
Butter the bread and layer with the beetroot, cheddar, mustard and pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Make the hot fudge sauce up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled and rewarm; whip the cream and put the toppings in bowls on the night

steps.text: Take the vanilla and chocolate ice cream out of the freezer to soften for 10 minutes.
Melt the dark chocolate with 150ml of the thickened cream over low heat, stirring, for hot fudge.
Whip the rest of the cream to soft peaks.
Chop the roasted peanuts and put them, the mini marshmallows, sprinkles and maraschino cherries in small bowls.
Set everything out with big bowls and let everyone build their own sundae.
